decisions.why: sampled product names (Mushroom Phaco Manipulator, Capsulorhexis Forceps, Desmarres Entropian Forceps, Jameson Strabismus Forceps, Castroviejo Scissors, Osher Neuman Corneal Marker, McPherson Bipolar Forceps) are all named ophthalmic microsurgery instruments; Altomed's whole site is an ophthalmic surgical instrument/consumables range, matching the 'Consumables & Single Use' division already mapped to ophthalmology:cons

the division is entirely Volk diagnostic/laser lenses (fundus, gonioscopy, SLT laser lenses) plus a portable fundus camera - diagnostic consumables used by ophthalmologists/optometrists, matching ophthalmology:optom's own description

products (Silicone/Lucite Conformer, Malhotra Platinum Segment Implant, Silicone Sphere) are ocular prosthetic/orbital implants used in ophthalmic surgery, the closest gated category to surgical implants/consumables
products (sterilising trays, Q-Rinse System) are durable ophthalmic theatre equipment for instrument sterilisation/rinsing, not single-use consumables
